title: Promises to kill (understanding threats)
coreMove: Read a threat by what it is trying to accomplish and what behavior surrounds it.
sourcePressure: Threats are data to interpret by function, context, and sequence; words alone are weaker than words embedded in a behavioral pattern.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Either dismissing threats as talk or treating any ugly sentence as certain violence.
sourceAnchorNote: Frozen notes contain no traceable named anecdote, study, place, date, or artifact for this chapter; use fictional protagonists only and keep claims tied to the listed source pressure.

starting with a definition of fear, intuition, danger, or prediction

trust your gut instead of overthinking
